title: 第1028章 剑阵发威第1027章 炼制双恒剑阵
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
轰！
整个火脉区域发生一次剧烈的摇晃。
嗖，嗖！
一些在炼器室里的修士，尤其是筑基期修士，甚至是几个金丹老祖，都直接冲了出来。
“什么情况，怎么刚才的地火如此猛烈？”
“是啊，这里不是有极其厉害的禁制，可以控制地火的规模吗？”
“难道，是神兽天龟的分身在作祟？”
四周的修士，都退出火脉区域，悬浮在空中，纷纷议论。
轰！
又是一声爆裂的声音。
这次，火脉区域的晃动更加凶猛。
“所有炼器室的人员，全部撤离！”
将军当机立断，用金丹老祖特殊的传音术给每个在火脉区域炼器室的修士，发出警告，或者说是一种无法抗拒的命令。
嗖，嗖，嗖！
各种灵光闪动，火脉区域的几乎所有修士，都踏着各种飞行器，冲了出来。
“报告将军，所有人员撤离完毕，除了一号城主炼器室的贵客！”
负责炼器室安全的一位卫兵过来报告。
“什么？”
将军微微皱起眉头。
他是知道的，城主非常器重这位贵客。

如果，这位贵客发生什么意外的话，将军自己难逃惩罚。
怎么办？
强行破除一号炼器室的禁制？
往日里，行事十分果决的将军，这一刻也左右为难。
轰！
第三次剧烈的晃动。
“不好，将军，地火似乎要彻底失控。”
手下大声嘶吼。
“怎么回事，怎么会出现这种突发状况？”
将军这句话更像是在问自己。
轰！
第四次晃动。
这一次，整个火脉区域竟然直接一个下沉。
“不好，要喷发地火中的岩浆了！”
不知谁大喊一句。
这下，四周的修士，吓得纷纷四散奔逃。
“快，释放最高级别紧急预警信号！”
将军大声嘶吼。
四下里的士兵，纷纷拿出一个特殊的装置。
启动装置！

嗖，嗖！
content_en:
boom!
The entire fire vein area shook violently.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Some of the monks in the refining room, especially the foundation-building monks and even a few golden elixir ancestors, rushed out.
"What happened? Why was the ground fire so fierce just now?"
"Yes, isn't there an extremely powerful restriction here that can control the scale of the underground fire?"
"Could it be that the clone of the divine beast Sky Turtle is causing trouble?"
The surrounding monks all withdrew from the fire vein area, suspended in the air, and talked one after another.
boom!
There was another crackling sound.
This time, the shaking in the fire vein area was even more violent.
"All personnel in the refining room must evacuate!"
The general made a prompt decision and used the golden elixir ancestor's special voice transmission technique to issue a warning, or an irresistible order, to every monk in the refining room in the fire vein area.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Various spiritual lights flashed, and almost all the monks in the fire vein area rushed out on various aircraft.
"Report to the general, all personnel have been evacuated, except for the distinguished guests in the weapon refining room of the No. 1 City Lord!"
A guard responsible for the security of the refining room came over to report.
"What?"
The general frowned slightly.
He knew that the city lord valued this distinguished guest very much.
If something unexpected happens to this distinguished guest, the general himself will not be able to escape punishment.
what to do?
Forcibly breaking the restrictions in the No. 1 refining room?
In the past, the general who acted very decisively was in a dilemma at this moment.
boom!
The third violent shaking.
"No, General, the ground fire seems to be completely out of control."
The men roared loudly.
"What's going on? How could such an emergency occur?"
The general's words were more like asking himself.
boom!
The fourth shake.
This time, the entire fire vein area sank directly.
"No, the magma from the underground fire is about to erupt!"
I don’t know who shouted something.
At this time, the monks around him were so frightened that they fled in all directions.
"Quick, release the highest level emergency warning signal!"
The general roared loudly.
The soldiers all around took out a special device.
Start the device!
Whoosh, whoosh!
